verdict.rationale: Termius documents secure access to servers through SSH, Mosh, Telnet, Serial and SFTP, with jump hosts, port forwarding, FIDO2/MFA and biometric keys. Cloud Sync imports hosts from AWS, DigitalOcean and Azure, which covers much of the 'wherever they live' part. Nothing in the evidence mentions Kubernetes cluster access, which the story names explicitly. Missing for 10: Kubernetes cluster access (kubectl/pod exec or cluster connectivity), coverage of resources beyond SSH-reachable hosts (databases, internal web apps), independent corroboration of the secure-access features.
